snippet.title: RpVoid Trailer
snippet.description:
Needed a trailer for RpVoid https://rpvoid.com
you can make an account to try the game on the same website

It's an online game on a persistent world, cozy chill if you want to just socialize or more hardcore if you want to go hunt creatures/explore. Multiplayer is already in so you can play with a friend

The game is still a wip, it has some bugs and edges that need polishing but is playable, if you want to help with balancing, join our discord https://discord.gg/a2EwYmj
